test.create_query: CREATE TABLE jit_date_comparisons ( d Date, d32 Date32, ts DateTime('UTC'), ts64 DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), value UInt32 ) Engine = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO jit_date_comparisons SELECT toDate(19000 + number % 2000), toDate32(19000 + number * 7 % 2000), toDateTime(1640000000 + number * 13 % 200000000, 'UTC'), fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(1640000000 + number * 17 % 200000000) * 1000 + number % 1000, 'UTC'), number % 1000 FROM numbers(50000000)
